title: 第19章 太乙剑术第20章 武斗场
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 持棍男子狼狈逃回去后，第一时间去了外门第一人石洛所在的院落。
一袭白衣的石洛，正在悠闲品茶。
“石洛师兄……”
持棍男子直接跪在地上，哭泣的说道：“那个秦易实力太强，我根本不是他的对手……”
石洛那刀削般的脸颊上，露出了一抹意味深长的笑容，这一切都在他的意料中。
让持棍男子去骚扰，只不过是一次警告而已，并没有让他能将秦易打残。
“好了，你下去吧。”石洛摆手道。
持棍男子欲言又止。
“还有事？”石洛皱眉。
“石洛师兄，那家伙要杀我，我拿出石洛师兄，他也不放过我，最后没办法，他逼迫我写下一万块下品灵石的欠条，并且落款处签上了你的名字……”持棍男子如实交代。
咔嚓！
石洛手中的茶杯，瞬间碎裂，茶水洒落在地上，热气腾腾。
他脸色阴沉，眼眸深处闪过了冰冷的杀意。
持棍男子吓得瑟瑟发抖，连连求饶，说这一切都是被秦易逼的。
“一万块下品灵石的欠条吗？”
良久后。
院落恢复正常，石洛脸上露出了一丝笑容。
“我敢承认，他敢来找我要吗？”
这便是外门第一人的霸气。
小胖带着秦易，几乎将外门的每一个角落都熟悉完了。
最后，他们两个来到了藏经阁。
“秦师弟，每一个新入门的弟子，都有一次进入藏经阁选择一门功法的机会。”小胖指着前边金碧辉煌的大殿说道。“藏经阁中，有无数珍贵典籍，但是我们外门弟子，只能在第一层选。”
秦易点头，他在弟子手册上也看到过相关介绍。
“别轻易下手，一定要选好。”小胖叮嘱道。
最后，他目送秦易，进入了藏经阁。
藏经阁第一层，有无数书架，每一个书架上，摆放着上百本书籍。
“不愧是江州仙宗，这么多功法。”秦易感慨，他走到第一个书架上，随便拿起一本翻看，“黄品功法《赤炎剑术》……”
功法跟武器的等级是一样的，统一分为天地玄黄。
黄品功法，在凡俗界算是不错的，但对于仙宗来说，只不过是一些不入流的功法而已。
秦易将这本书籍放下，又接连拿起几本看。
就这样，他开始认真挑选。
半个时辰后。
他将整个藏经阁第一层的书籍，全部看完了。
总共有黄品功法一万册，玄品功法三千册，地品功法三册。
秦易站在最前方，看着石台上的三本泛黄书籍，分别是《焰浪剑术》，《柔水剑术》，《黑魔剑术》。
content_en:
After the stick-wielding man fled back in embarrassment, he immediately went to the courtyard where Shi Luo, the first person in the outer sect, was located.
Shi Luo, dressed in white, was enjoying tea leisurely.
"Senior Brother Shi Luo..."
The man holding the stick knelt directly on the ground and cried: "That Qin Yi is too strong, I am no match for him..."
A meaningful smile appeared on Shi Luo's knife-like cheeks, and everything was as he expected.
Letting the man with the stick harass him was just a warning and did not allow him to cripple Qin Yi.
"Okay, you go down." Shi Luo waved his hand.
The man holding the stick stopped talking.
"Is there anything else?" Shi Luo frowned.
"Senior Brother Shi Luo, that guy wanted to kill me. I took out Senior Brother Shi Luo, but he didn't let me go. In the end, he had no choice but to force me to write an IOU for 10,000 low-grade spiritual stones, and signed your name on the payment..." The man holding the stick told the truth.
Click!
The tea cup in Shi Luo's hand shattered instantly, and the tea spilled onto the ground, steaming.
His face was gloomy, and a cold murderous intent flashed in the depths of his eyes.
The man holding the stick was so frightened that he begged for mercy, saying that Qin Yi had forced him to do this.
"IOU for ten thousand low-grade spiritual stones?"
After a long time.
The courtyard returned to normal, and a smile appeared on Shi Luo's face.
"I dare to admit it, but he dares to come to me and ask for it?"
This is the domineering power of the first person in the outer sect.
…………
Xiaopang took Qin Yi and became familiar with almost every corner of the outer gate.
Finally, the two of them came to the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion.
"Junior Brother Qin, every new disciple has an opportunity to enter the Sutra Pavilion and choose a technique." Xiaopang pointed to the magnificent hall in front and said. "There are countless precious books in the Scripture Pavilion, but we outer disciples can only choose from the first floor."
Qin Yi nodded. He had also seen relevant introductions in the disciple manual.
"Don't act easily, be sure to choose well." Xiaopang warned.
Finally, he watched Qin Yi enter the Scripture Collection Pavilion.
On the first floor of the Sutra Pavilion, there are countless bookshelves, and hundreds of books are placed on each bookshelf.
"As expected of Jiangzhou Immortal Sect, there are so many techniques." Qin Yi sighed. He walked to the first bookshelf, picked up a book and flipped through it, "Huangpin Kung Fu "Red Flame Swordsmanship"..."
The levels of skills and weapons are the same, and they are divided into heaven, earth, black and yellow.
Huangpin skills are considered good in the mortal world, but to the Immortal Sect, they are just some inferior skills.
Qin Yi put down the book and picked up a few more to read.
In this way, he began to carefully select.
Half an hour later.
He read all the books on the first floor of the Scripture Collection Pavilion.
There are a total of 10,000 volumes of Huangpin techniques, 3,000 volumes of Xuanpin techniques, and three volumes of Earthly techniques.
Qin Yi stood at the front, looking at the three yellowed books on the stone platform, which were "Fire Wave Swordsmanship", "Soft Water Swordsmanship", and "Black Demon Swordsmanship".
